name: dsh-client-ui-workspace-suite
description: Workspace suite for the DSH Web client: an explorer-style picker (browse, inline folder creation, path input, enter-which-workspace chooser), a nested workspace tree with collapse-all and cascade delete, a per-workspace overview page (subtree token totals, expanded session tree, turn jumps, dependencies card, README), and a root-level conversation workspace menu.

scripts.test: node tools/test-manifest.mjs && node tools/test-styles.mjs && node tools/test-host.mjs && node tools/test-util.mjs && node tools/test-i18n.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs
